scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 13 attributable financing, grant and ownership events for 11 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: BAE Systems confirms completion of the Kirintec acquisition
BAE Systems FY2024 results report GBP252m cash consideration for Kirintec

rounds.note_en: BAE Systems reports GBP252m gross cash consideration, GBP40m cash acquired and GBP212m net cash outflow. The gross consideration is recorded as secondary acquisition consideration, not issuer growth proceeds.
rounds.coverage_note_en: BAE Systems' completed 2024 acquisition is recorded at GBP252m gross cash consideration; the amount is secondary consideration rather than issuer proceeds.

sources.title: Kongsberg confirms NOK200m Norwegian-authority support for missile production capacity

rounds.note_en: Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace announced NOK640m of company investment and NOK200m contributed by Norwegian authorities. Only the public contribution is recorded as financing; issuer capital expenditure is not.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-confirmed 2024 Norwegian and EU public contributions to missile-production capacity are recorded separately in original currencies.

sources.title: Kongsberg confirms EUR10m EU ASAP support for missile production capacity

rounds.note_en: Kongsberg states that the EU Act in Support of Ammunition Production contributes EUR10m to the capacity programme. The award is kept separate from the Norwegian-authority contribution and Kongsberg's own investment.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-confirmed 2024 Norwegian and EU public contributions to missile-production capacity are recorded separately in original currencies.

sources.title: CIG confirms its 2017 investment in Kray Technologies
Contemporary report describes the Kray investment agreement and production use

rounds.note_en: CIG confirms the investment and contemporary reporting says three investors funded production. The total amount and the two other investor identities were not disclosed, so no cheque size or unsupported participant is invented.
rounds.coverage_note_en: CIG's 2017 investment is recorded with undisclosed amount; secondary databases report additional historical activity that is not reconciled to issuer or transaction-party evidence.

sources.title: Kseonics confirms a Brave1 grant for production of 150 drone detectors

rounds.note_en: The company confirms that it won a Brave1 grant tied to producing 150 drone detectors, but the award amount is not public. A founder-level UAH30,000 early business credit lacks lender, exact date and issuer attribution and is not imported.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-confirmed 2023 Brave1 grant is recorded with undisclosed amount; planned applications and an insufficiently attributable early credit are excluded.

sources.title: Leonardo and Baykar announce establishment of the 50:50 LBA Systems joint venture

rounds.note_en: The parties announced the established Italian 50:50 joint venture. Initial capital and any cash contribution were not disclosed, so no amount is inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2025 establishment of LBA Systems as a 50:50 Leonardo-Baykar joint venture is recorded with undisclosed initial capital.

rounds.stage: Acquisition of outstanding Leica Geosystems shares

sources.title: Hexagon confirms acquisition of the outstanding Leica Geosystems shares and 99.2% ownership

rounds.note_en: Hexagon states that it acquired the outstanding shares and reached 99.2% ownership. Consideration comprised CHF440 plus five Hexagon B shares per Leica share; no unsupported aggregate cash equivalent is calculated.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Hexagon's 2005 acquisition of the outstanding Leica Geosystems shares is recorded with mixed per-share consideration and no inferred aggregate amount.

sources.title: Liebherr confirms EUR2.4m state co-financing for its Toulouse aerospace project

rounds.note_en: Liebherr-Aerospace Toulouse describes an approximately EUR5m project co-financed by the French state at EUR2.4m. Only the public support is recorded, not the total project spending.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-confirmed EUR2.4m France Relance co-financing for the Toulouse aerospace project is recorded.

rounds.coverage_note_en: Two beneficiary-specific UK government radar-mitigation grants are recorded; earlier programme participation without a company allocation remains excluded.

rounds.coverage_note_en: Two beneficiary-specific UK government radar-mitigation grants are recorded; earlier programme participation without a company allocation remains excluded.

sources.title: European Investment Bank project page records EUR50m signed financing for Latvijas Mobilais Telefons

rounds.note_en: The EIB records EUR50m of signed financing for the EUR101m network-development project. The project cost is not treated as proceeds.

sources.title: Latvian Ministry of Defence archive lists EUR64,425 for LV-Teh's remote-controlled demining system

rounds.note_en: The ministry lists the beneficiary-specific amount in its 2023-2024 defence innovation grant competition. The checked archive does not expose an exact award day, so year precision is preserved.

sources.title: Lynred confirms France 2030 financial support for its IPCEI ME/CT 2026 project
French government lists Lynred among selected French IPCEI ME/CT companies

rounds.note_en: Lynred confirms financial support but publishes only its own approximately EUR111m planned project investment, not the company-specific grant amount. The national maximum across multiple French projects is not assigned to Lynred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-confirmed 2023 France 2030 support is recorded with undisclosed amount; Lynred's own project investment is not treated as external financing.
